message.content: the retry budget on the ingest worker keeps blowing up, what do you think
Right now it retries five times with a fixed one second sleep. Under load that turns one slow upstream into five slow calls per job.
cap it at three retries with exponential backoff
Done: three attempts, backoff 1s, 2s, 4s. Tests pass.
good. reason is the upstream has a 3 second p99, so anything past 4s of waiting is almost never going to succeed anyway and just holds the worker
Recorded in the pull request body.
